scientific_integrity: All-parameter assertions are proved by explicit scheme-level Schur complements and Segre intersection theory; finite-field and combinatorial checks are supporting evidence and not general proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes algebraically closed field of characteristic different from two; classifies the projective scheme defined by all three-by-three minors and the support of its singular locus, not the nonreduced Jacobian singular scheme or characteristic-two analogues.
title: Rank-two hollow symmetric determinantal sections: Segre components and product-node singularities
